text:
maria_cheng: Quick sync — RetailCo POC scheduled Mon. They want to validate perf before committing. Customer requirement: 99th pct < 150ms for text-gen at 2k QPS sustained (batching ok) and < 50ms tail for embeddings at 500 QPS.

leo_kim: Thanks. Are they on hosted or want Dedicated for POC?

maria_cheng: Initially hosted with burst to Dedicated if we need. Pricing question — how do we bill for sustained 2k QPS during a 48h POC? Need a clean estimate for their procurement.

sam_patel: @maria_cheng two quick clarifying q's: which model (open vs redwood-optim)? and avg prompt tokens? Also are they ok with batching (added latency) vs single-token latency?

maria_cheng: They prefer our 'rw-v2' family (approx 8k context), avg prompt ~60 tokens, target gen len 40 tokens. Batching ok but we must keep P99 <150ms.

jordan_reyes: From infra side: sustaining 2k QPS with those sizes likely needs ~4 instances of c5g? sorry typo — 8x A100 or equivalent. We'll run a 3-phase load plan: smoke, ramp, sustain (48h), then spike + graceful degrade. We'll use KV cache + prefix caching to hit tail.

sam_patel: Proposed k6 plan snippet for load generator:
```
export default function () {
  http.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({model:'rw-v2', prompt:'<payload>'}), {headers: {Authorization: 'Bearer ${POC_TOKEN}'}})
}
```
Ramp: 0->2k QPS over 15min. Sustain: 2k QPS for 48h. Spike: 4k for 2 min.

maria_cheng: Good. Leo — for pricing, can we give them a POC rate (hosted): blended token price + a short-term reserved capacity uplift? Procurement prefers a single line item.

leo_kim: Yes. Suggest: POC flat fee for 48h stress + per-token for overage. I'll draft numbers: $12k flat + $0.0005/token overage estimate. Will confirm margins.

deploy-bot: infra: started test cluster poc-retail-1767423456 in us-west-2 on dedicated-pool-3. Nodes: 8xA100. Logs: https://internal.logs/poc/1767423456

jordan_reyes: Note: we should enable canary fallback to smaller model if latency spikes. Also enable regional split (us-west + eu-west) to avoid single AZ saturation.

sam_patel: I'll prepare a short runbook for the customer's SREs with curl examples and tracing headers. Also capture per-route p50/p95/p99 token-level cost. Will attach results writeup after 48h.

maria_cheng: Perfect — can we reconvene Fri 10am to finalize the pricing & test script? @sam_patel @leo_kim @jordan_reyes

leo_kim: yes

sam_patel: yep

jordan_reyes: 👍
